comment: The nuclide as one event (the mathematician's 105, A1, and 106, item 1, at the owner's word of 2026-10-02, about 06:20 Israel, 'try it; the derivation says a great deal, because our model knows how to represent an atom and a nucleus'; ALGEBRA.md #the-click-is-the-meeting, The GHZ gate; #what-is-open, item 1, the masses are families; #the-count-is-the-records-share, The click's unit: the whole of a click is the detector's own transition): every number of the one world read by build_world.py, which writes the world file, its mode file (tools/pixel_mode.py, the message lay, with --modes) and the blind expectation file, written from the law's lines before any run and never touched after. One square board of `length` x `length` Nodes (z folded) on the universe file `universe` (examples/events/nuclide/deuteron.json: the holder of the sign at the level weight 1 and the nuclide family `family` at the pair `pair`, the shape [2, 2], two planes laid as one event and never summed at a Node; no holder of the content, neither gravity's row nor the binding holder, so the record is free and nothing is laid in a holder; the loader admits parts of one dimension alone, so the neutron is the second plane with its second level pair 0, a real record, and the proton the first plane, whose sense the message lay cannot carry: the lay is a real packet, ALGEBRA.md #the-generator (h), and both parts are laid real and alike). The pair: the free nucleon's rest rotation omega_p is the matter pair's, `nucleon_pair` [4000, 6000], cos omega_p = 2 / 3, and the nuclide's rest rotation per part is omega_N = (1 - b_d) omega_p with the deuteron's binding fraction b_d = 2.2246 MeV / (m_p + m_n) = 0.00119 (`binding_fraction`, 1 - b_d = 0.99881, 105 A2), the nearest integer numerator at the denominator 6,000 being 4,004 (omega_N / omega_p = 0.998936, the deficit 1.064 x 10^-3 against the asked 1.19 x 10^-3; 4,003 gives 7.98 x 10^-4 and 4,005 1.33 x 10^-3; the resolution of the denominator, stated and not hidden). The record laid as one event at the centre Node (`source`, `source`): three messages of the nuclide family at the wave `wave` (k = pi / 4, lambda = 8), one toward each counter's face as `beams` lists them (the axis and the direction), the raised-cosine edge `edge_along` along the beam and the flat top `top_across` with the edge `edge_across` across it, at the amplitude `amplitude`, every message laid on the two parts alike (the symmetric lay, GameBoard.lay); the message lay's level before is at the vacuum's band (ALGEBRA.md #the-generator (h)), so on a gapped family the laid packet is not the family's own travelling wave and part of it runs the other way, a matter of the GameBoard that no blind row rests on. Three counters, each one declared region of `screen` Nodes deep along its beam and `top_across` wide across it, the board's last layer before its face, backed by the receding faces `receding` (every face recedes, opaque, so no face layer reports): `left` and `right` on the x sides declaring the nuclide's whole W_d = 2 T sin omega_N (`wholes.nuclide`, two parts of one quantum each, one quantum's energy T sin omega_N by the families reading, ALGEBRA.md #what-is-open, item 1) and `top` on the y side declaring one part's whole T sin omega_N (`wholes.part`); the whole is the reader's divisor of the region's inflow and no key of the engine, the engine's region crediting the share over W_c = 3 den T. `ticks` intervals, the reading over `window`, the whole passage; the nuclide packet's group velocity at k = pi / 4 along an axis is (num / den) sin k / (3 sin omega) = 0.197 Links per interval at cos omega = (num / den) (cos k + 2) / 3, against light's 0.547, so the passage takes about three times the GHZ gate's. The reading: the `click` lines of the three counters over the window (tools/click_counts.py, `inflows`), each inflow the nuclide family's net current through the counter's front, summed over the two parts, and the `parts` lines, per interval and region the two parts' signed level sums [now, before] (tools/bell_gate.py, `reports` and `mismatch`); the GameBoard readings beside them labelled so.

nuclide.formula: W_d = 2 T sin omega_N, the nuclide's own transition, two parts of one quantum each

part.formula: T sin omega_N, one part's transition

binding_fraction.formula: omega_N = (1 - b_d) omega_p per part, the nuclide's rest rotation below the free nucleon's by the binding fraction; cos omega_N = num / den at the nearest integer numerator, the denominator matter's

rule: a counter's inflow over the window is the nuclide family's net current through its front, summed over the two parts, in the current's units; its share is the inflow over W_c = 3 den T; its count N is the share over the declared whole over T, 2 sin omega_N for the nuclide counters and sin omega_N for the part counter (The click's unit: the whole of a click is the node_reader's own transition; the energy of one quantum of a family T sin omega by the families reading); the parts lines give the two parts' signed level sums per interval and region

equal_parts.reading: every `parts` line of the three counters over the window: the two parts' [now, before] sums
equal_parts.blind: bit-identical at every interval and every counter, the parts' mismatch ratios 1 and every squares ratio 1
equal_parts.status: theorem: the two parts are laid equal by the symmetric lay and stepped by one deterministic Rule3 on one board with no holder telling them apart (the holder of the sign reads the Wronskian, 0 on both), so they stay equal bit for bit; the GHZ gate's own equal-parts theorem with two parts and the holders removed (106, item 1)
equal_parts.fence: clicks (the instrument's read); the arrays' equality a GameBoard reading beside it

whole_clicks.reading: every `click` line's inflow on the three counters over the window, and each counter's inflow summed
whole_clicks.blind: every inflow is an even integer, twice one part's current, so a counter reading with the nuclide's whole 2 T sin omega_N credits whole nuclides and never a half; the part counter's count by T sin omega_N is exactly twice the same inflow's count by 2 T sin omega_N, and the part counter clicks nothing the nuclide counters' whole does not credit whole
whole_clicks.status: theorem under equal parts: the inflow is the family's current summed over its two lines pairs, each part's current the same integer; derived from the law's lines (the count is the record's share; the click's unit the node_reader's own transition)

equal_shares.reading: the parts' squares ratios per counter from the `parts` lines (tools/bell_gate.py, mismatch), and the parts' arrays
equal_shares.blind: the two parts' shares equal in every region at every interval, the ratio 1 exactly
equal_shares.status: theorem, the same equality: the share is a function of a part's own levels
equal_shares.fence: clicks for the parts lines; GameBoard for the arrays

sign_holder.reading: the holder of the sign's `field` lines at the counters and its level over the board
sign_holder.blind: 0 everywhere at every interval: the message lay lays a real packet (ALGEBRA.md #the-generator (h)), both parts' second level pairs 0, their Wronskian 0, so nothing sources the holder and its rest is 0; the one-plane source's far level, 3 (W / T) / (4 pi Gamma r) at the sense +1, is what a proton laid with a sense would give and this lay cannot carry, said so
sign_holder.status: derived from the lay as written; the sense of the proton part waits for a lay that carries it (the generator's sense is for bodies alone)
sign_holder.fence: GameBoard: a holder's level is a reading and no click
